items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1971-04-20
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I know Stan at all, I think, put up the money.

ctx.x: We was playing this program for all the soldiers going for the L&M. The L&M.
I know Stan at all, I think, put up the money. I know the program. I got tapes of it.
Well, that's who we was playing for. And we had Jimmy Noon on clarinet, Papa Mudd on trumpet. No Papa Mudd.
